name: web-dark-game-store-hero-with-fanned-game-cards
title: Dark Game Store with Fanned Cards
whatItIs: A dark game-store hero in a rounded frame with a centred headline, floating 3D icons on a perspective grid, and a fan of tall coloured game cards (purple, red, blue, green, yellow) with character art and ratings at the base.
whatItMeans: Saturated cards against black feel exciting, and the fan shape pulls the eye toward the centre card.
techniques: Fan of tall cards in different hues
Compact nav with currency and avatar

vocabulary.definition: Cards arranged in an arc, overlapping at the base.
Receding grid lines giving depth to a background.
A small pill showing a score on a card.
